about_the_game:
You are not the hero. You don’t explore. You don’t fight. You watch.

Stationed on a remote surveillance outpost at the edge of deep space, your only task is to monitor security feeds. But something’s wrong. A chair shifts. A shadow lingers. A figure appears where no one should be.
Welcome to First Shift, the chilling debut of the Observer Protocol series — a minimalist surveillance horror game where quiet tension and creeping dread take center stage.

Flip between camera feeds, scanning for subtle, unsettling changes. Miss an anomaly, and it spreads. Doubt what you saw, and the truth slips further away.
Inspired by I'm on Observation Duty, First Shift trades jump scares for an oppressive, slow-burn psychological horror experience.

Can you trust your eyes? Or is something watching you back?

Key Features:

  • Immersive anomaly-spotting gameplay rooted in pattern recognition and subtle environmental changes

  • Isolated deep-space setting that amplifies paranoia and claustrophobia

  • No combat, no jump scares — just tension, surveillance, and creeping unease

  • Ideal for fans of I’m on Observation Duty, Five Nights at Freddy’s, and psychological horror games

  • Part of the Observer Protocol series — expanding into new locations and unseen threats

short_description: A minimalist surveillance horror game. Flip through security cameras on a deep space station and report subtle anomalies. No jump scares. No combat. Just watch, observe, and try not to miss the moment everything goes wrong.
